text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't say that! Keep your
head high.
You did a great job!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
All right, time for me to give it a shot!
Teach, can
I borrow a coin or two from
ya?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Shucks, well... I guess I could make it up
with a
huge meal for the newbies.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
